The objective of this project is to deploy, configure, test, and commission a robust, secure, and high-performance
Huawei data center infrastructure for the Bank of China (BOC). The proposed solution comprises Huawei
OceanStor Dorado 2000 enterprise storage, Huawei FusionCube compute infrastructure, Huawei CloudEngine
6800 Top-of-Rack (ToR) switches, and the associated software licenses and support services.
NETS International will deliver the project as a complete infrastructure deployment, covering the installation and
configuration of the storage platform, compute infrastructure, and virtualization environment. The solution will
be integrated to establish a reliable platform capable of supporting the customer's enterprise applications and
virtualized workloads while ensuring operational efficiency and business continuity.
All implementation activities shall be performed in accordance with Huawei deployment guidelines, OEM best
practices, and internationally accepted industry standards. Upon successful completion, the customer will receive
a fully deployed and operational infrastructure platform validated through testing, commissioning, and formal
project handover.
5. Scope of Work
The scope of work covers the deployment, configuration, testing, and commissioning of the Huawei enterprise
infrastructure solution. The project includes Huawei OceanStor enterprise storage, Huawei FusionCube compute
infrastructure, Huawei CloudEngine switching, and virtualization platform deployment. NETS International shall
perform all implementation activities using qualified technical resources to ensure a stable, secure, and
production-ready infrastructure environment.

section: Deployment of Huawei FusionCube Compute Infrastructure

5.1 Hardware Installation
NETS shall rack, install, and power on the Huawei FusionCube platform and OceanStor Dorado 2000 storage
system in accordance with Huawei installation guidelines. All hardware interconnections required for the solution
shall be completed, and all newly installed cables associated with the deployment shall be properly labeled.

NETS shall perform the initial configuration of the deployed hardware, including management access and system
initialization. The firmware and software components of the FusionCube platform and OceanStor Dorado 2000
storage system shall be upgraded or aligned to Huawei validated and supported software versions where
applicable.

NETS shall configure the OceanStor Dorado 2000 storage system in accordance with the approved solution design
and Huawei best practices. This includes the creation of storage pools, logical storage resources, host mappings,
and multipathing configuration as required. Storage efficiency features shall be configured where supported,
licensed, and approved by the customer.

NETS shall deploy and configure the virtualization platform, including Huawei FusionCompute, VMware ESXi, or
other supported hypervisors as applicable. The management platform shall be deployed and configured, and the

5.5 Testing & User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
NETS shall perform functional validation of the deployed solution, including verification of hardware health,
storage accessibility, management functionality, network connectivity, and high availability mechanisms in
accordance with the agreed testing procedures. Upon successful completion of the validation activities, NETS shall
facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and obtain customer sign-off.

Upon completion of the deployment, NETS shall provide updated as-built documentation reflecting the
implemented solution. NETS shall also conduct a knowledge transfer session of up to four (4) hours covering
routine system administration, health monitoring, and basic operational procedures.

The objective of this project is to deploy Huawei’s Software-Defined Wide Area Network (SD-WAN) solution across
Bank Islami’s branch network and data center infrastructure. The initiative aims to optimize branch connectivity,
enhance application performance, improve bandwidth utilization, reduce operational costs, and ensure seamless
failover and security through centralized orchestration and intelligent routing.

This project is focused on the design, deployment, and enablement of Huawei’s SD-WAN for Bank Islami. The scope
includes the following key deliverables and activities:
Network Assessment & Planning
•
Conduct assessment of Bank Islami’s existing WAN environment.
•
Identify branch site types, link availability, and application requirements.
•
Define site roles (e.g., hub, spoke) and classify bandwidth needs.

•
Develop High-Level Design (HLD) tailored to Bank Islami’s connectivity model.
•
Define SD-WAN overlay and underlay architecture.
•
Design secure communication tunnels using IPSec.

•
Centralized management
Deployment & Configuration
•
Configure SD-WAN devices based on site classification and routing policies.
•
Deploy Huawei iMaster NCE-Campus SD-WAN Controller for centralized orchestration.
•
Implement Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) for remote branch onboarding.
•
Integrate MPLS, broadband, and LTE links as part of the hybrid WAN model.

This SD-WAN solution provides secure, scalable, and high-performance connectivity across Bank Islami’s network,
including over 720 remote branches, a primary Data Center (DC) in Karachi, and a Disaster Recovery (DR) site in
Islamabad. The design incorporates Huawei’s advanced routing, orchestration, and fabric technologies.

•
720 Branches connect via Huawei AR651 routers to the central SD-WAN fabric using IPSec VPN tunnels.
•
These remote sites communicate securely through the SD-WAN cloud to reach both DC and DR sites.
•
Policies and configurations are centrally managed via the Huawei iMaster NCE controller.

•
The SD-WAN core fabric acts as the centralized communication layer between all connected sites.
•
IPSec VPN Routers (2 units) provide encryption and route traffic to/from remote sites into the SD-WAN
network.
•
L3 Sync Links are shown between the two IPSec VPN routers to ensure redundancy and synchronization for
controller states.
DC Site – Karachi
•
NE8K Routers handle ISP link termination.
•
These NE8K routers are connected via 1G Copper to AR8140 Hub Routers.
•
AR8140 Hub Routers serve as the SD-WAN Hub Routers and are interconnected using 10G Fiber links.
•
These hub routers connect downstream to:
o
iMaster NCE-Campus Cluster (Active) – for control and orchestration.
o
Border + Services Leaf Switches – to enable efficient traffic handling and integration with internal and
external networks.
•
There’s also 10G interconnectivity between the NCE Cluster and the switching layer.
DR Site – Islamabad
•
NE8K Routers similarly provide ISP link termination.
•
These are connected to AR8140 Hub Routers via 1G Copper.
•
The AR8140 Hub Routers connect via 10G Fiber to:
o
iMaster NCE-Campus Cluster (Standby) – backup control and management node.
o
Border + Services Leaf Switches – parallel function to DC, ensuring active-standby data center
redundancy.

4. Objective
NETS proposes to deliver a fully managed, enterprise-grade Network Operations Center (NOC) service for Data
Check to support critical network and security assets. This solution ensures uninterrupted operations through
monitoring, rapid incident response and proactive maintenance at both the Primary and Disaster Recovery (DR)
sites. By leveraging an experienced engineering team and advanced monitoring tools, NETS aims to significantly
reduce downtime and improve overall network performance.
5. Scope of Services
NETS shall provide Network Operations Center (NOC) services for continuous monitoring of the Data Check’s IT
and network infrastructure during the agreed service window. Monitoring shall be performed using a Network
Management System (NMS) to ensure proactive detection of faults, performance degradation
and service interruptions.

The NETS NOC will provide comprehensive proactive and reactive support for the network infrastructure by
managing specific inventory assets. This includes the monitoring and management of Linux servers and physical
servers to ensure stable service hosting. The scope also covers security enforcement using Fortinet firewalls, WAN
routing via Cisco routers and campus connectivity through Cisco core switches. Additionally, the team will manage
Virtual Network Management (VNM) units and provide endpoint security monitoring for antivirus users.

The NOC will perform continuous monitoring of all assets through an enterprise-grade Network Monitoring
System to detect performance degradation or outages early. This process includes tracking link status, CPU and
memory utilization and firewall threat logs to maintain a high security posture. Our engineers will conduct detailed
remote diagnostics, such as log analysis and configuration reviews, to resolve issues from our office. If a hardware
failure or physical-layer problem is identified that cannot be fixed remotely, NETS will provide on-site engineering
support to restore services at the affected site.

All device-generated alerts will be captured and automatically categorized by severity into Critical, Major and
Minor levels. This structured alarm management framework enables efficient prioritization and fast response to
high-impact incidents affecting branch operations or security.
5.4 Ticketing System
NETS will maintain a centralized ticketing platform that automatically creates tickets based on NMS alarms or Data
Check’s requests. Each ticket will track incident progress, actions taken, escalation notes, final resolution details
and visibility into active and closed tickets. All user-base tickets will be generated and controlled on portal through
which NETS-NOC will align engineer to resolve end-user issue.

The NOC will conduct detailed remote diagnostics, including log analysis, configuration review, fault isolation and
minor configuration changes such as switchport adjustments or firewall rule updates, subject to Data Check’s
approval. Software installation problem, connectivity issues, driver problems, windows-based issues will be
troubleshooted and resolve by NETS NOC team.

The NOC will actively monitor VPN tunnel status, firewall threat logs and intrusion detection or prevention alerts
(IDS/IPS) where supported. This enhances the security posture through continuous visibility into network-based
threats and anomalies.

Technical support from qualified engineers is guaranteed whenever a trouble ticket is raised within the

The primary objective of this project is to provide the required Hypervisor licensing to enable a secure, scalable
and fully compliant virtualization environment within ENAR Petroleum’s IT infrastructure. The project aims to
ensure that all deployed hypervisor instances are properly licensed, optimized for performance and reliability.
Through this implementation, ENAR Petroleum will enhance resource utilization, strengthen infrastructure
resilience and ensure long-term scalability of its virtualized workloads. The licensing framework will also ensure
compliance with standards and support eligibility for future upgrades and technical assistance.
5. Scope of Services
NETS International proposes to undertake the complete procurement, deployment, configuration and migration
of ENAR Petroleum’s existing VMware-based virtualization infrastructure to the Sangfor Virtualization platform.
This project will be executed on a full turnkey basis, whereby NETS International shall be end-to-end responsible
for licensing, design validation, deployment, migration, replication setup, backup configuration, testing,
documentation and training. The detailed scope is as follows:

The scope includes the supply of Sangfor Hypervisor licenses. All licenses will be genuine, vendor-authorized and
compliant with the required licensing model as specified. The supplied licenses will be validated for compatibility
with ENAR Petroleum’s existing hardware infrastructure to ensure seamless deployment and operation.
5.1.1 Sangfor Virtualization & Management Licenses
The NETS International shall supply, install and activate the Sangfor virtualization and management licenses as
specified. This includes Sangfor SCP (Cloud Platform) Licenses for 10 sockets, which provide centralized
management and orchestration of the Sangfor Virtualization cluster. Additionally, Sangfor aSV (Application &
Server Virtualization) licenses for 10 sockets shall be provided, serving as the core virtualization licenses required
for hosting both production and replica virtual machines. The NETS International shall also provide Sangfor ASV
for OVF/OVA download (built-in), enabling seamless importing and exporting of virtual machines in OVF/OVA
formats.

The NETS International shall supply licenses to support replication, backup and disaster recovery requirements.
This includes Sangfor aRD (Advanced Recovery & Disaster Recovery) licenses for 10 virtual machines, providing
VM-level replication and backup capabilities along with recovery, restore and disaster recovery testing
functionality. Furthermore, Sangfor Cloud Platform licenses shall be provided to ensure the platform fully supports
all backup, replication and virtualization operations.
5.1.3 Support & Subscription
All supplied licenses shall include a two-year support and subscription package, covering software updates and
upgrades, NETS International and OEM-backed technical support and all relevant security patches and bug fixes
to ensure smooth and secure operation of the virtualization and replication environment.

8

The NETS International shall be responsible for the full installation and configuration of the Sangfor Virtualization
suite on all five physical servers. This includes forming and optimizing the virtualization cluster and configuring
compute resources, storage pools and networking components. The deployment scope also covers the
configuration of Sangfor aRD for backup and replication, as well as enabling OVF/OVA import and export
capabilities to facilitate virtual machine portability.

The NETS International shall provide end-to-end migration services from the existing VMware environment to the
Sangfor Virtualization platform. This process involves migrating the current workloads to interim servers, verifying
the virtual machines, data and services on the interim cluster, formatting the existing client servers and installing
the Sangfor Virtualization suite. Subsequently, the VMs will be remigrated from the interim cluster to the client
servers, followed by verification of all VMs, data and services.
The migration scope includes 15 production virtual machines and 10 replica virtual machines. The activities will
cover migration planning and sequencing, execution with minimal downtime, verification of data integrity, post-
migration validation and final sign-off.
5.4 Testing & Validation
The NETS International shall conduct comprehensive testing and validation of the deployed environment. This
includes functional testing of all virtual machines, Sangfor aSV and SCP services and aRD backup and replication
jobs. Backup restore and disaster recovery testing will be performed, along with performance and stability testing.
The NETS International shall also support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure all services meet operational
requirements.
5.5 Documentation
The NETS International shall deliver complete project documentation encompassing s, license inventory and
activation detailsand detailed configuration documentation for compute, storage and networking. Documentation
shall also include backup and replication policies (aRD), standard operating procedures (SOPs)and administrator
and troubleshooting guides to support ongoing management and operations.

9

The NETS International shall have end-to-end responsibility for supply and licensing, deployment and
configuration, migration from VMware, testing and validation, backup and replication setup, documentation,
training and coordination of support with Sangfor during the subscription period.
7. Deliverables
The deliverables include Sangfor aSV licenses for 10 sockets, Sangfor aRD licenses for 10 VMs, Sangfor SCP licenses
for 10 units, OVF/OVA support, built-in backup software with no limits on the number or size of VMs, a fully
deployed and migrated Sangfor Virtualization environment, a configured backup and replication solution, a fully
tested and validated platform, complete project documentation, training for IT personnel and two years of
support.

integrated humidity control (humidification and dehumidification) and air cleaning filtration systems. Matching
outdoor condensing units shall be supplied in accordance with the PAC capacity. The solution include intelligent
controllers, temperature and humidity sensors at rack and room levels, monitoring devices, refrigerant piping
kits with insulated copper piping and accessories, electrical distribution components, dual power input
arrangement, power and control cabling and earthing materials compliant with standards. All supplied
equipment shall be suitable for continuous 24x7 operation.

The objective of this project is to supply, install, configure, and commission Top-of-Rack (ToR) switches at First
Women Bank Limited's Primary (PR) and Disaster Recovery (DR) sites. The deployment aims to establish a reliable,
scalable, and highly available switching infrastructure at the Primary site, while ensuring connectivity at the DR
site. NETS will undertake the required installation, configuration, commissioning, and testing activities to integrate
the proposed switches into the existing network environment in accordance with FWBL's technical requirements.
The project will also include User Acceptance Testing (UAT), technical support, and final documentation and
handover.
5. Scope of Work
The scope of work encompasses the end-to-end supply, delivery, installation, configuration, testing,
commissioning, and support of ToR switches at FWBL.
5.1 Supply and Delivery
NETS shall supply and deliver three (03) ToR switches, along with the required software licences, optical
transceivers, DAC cables, and OEM support coverage. The equipment and associated components shall be
delivered to the designated FWBL location.
5.2 Installation and Configuration
NETS shall carry out the physical installation, configuration, and commissioning of the proposed ToR switches at
the Primary and DR sites. This shall include mounting the switches in the designated racks, connecting the required
power and network interfaces, and configuring the devices in accordance with the approved network design and
FWBL's requirements.
The configuration activities shall include the required VLANs, interface settings, link aggregation, routing
parameters, redundancy mechanisms, and applicable security hardening. At the Primary site, the two switches
shall be configured to support the agreed high-availability architecture, while the DR switch shall be integrated
into the existing DR network environment. NETS shall also perform the necessary connectivity and operational
checks to verify the functionality of the deployed solution.

The proposed switches include five (05) years of OEM support. NETS shall provide five years of technical support
for the deployed solution which includes remote support and onsite on-demand support. NETS technical support
shall include technical assistance, troubleshooting, and warranty-related matters to ensure continued operational
support throughout the agreed support period.

NETS shall conduct User Acceptance Testing in coordination with FWBL to verify the operational functionality and
integration of the deployed ToR switches. Testing shall cover device connectivity, interface status, link aggregation,
routing functionality, and high-availability at the Primary site.
5.5 Final Documentation and Handover
Upon successful completion of the implementation and UAT activities, NETS shall provide the relevant project
documentation and hand over the deployed solution to FWBL. The handover documentation shall include the
High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), device configurations, IP and VLAN details, port mapping, testing
reports.

The objective of this project is to deploy a high-performance edge router at Getz Pharma to enhance network
resilience, routing performance, and business continuity. The solution will provide secure and scalable routing
through advanced routing capabilities, while supporting high availability, redundant connectivity, and seamless
integration with the existing network infrastructure. The project will also include three years of OEM and vendor
support to ensure reliable operation, maintenance, and future scalability.
5. Scope of Work
The scope of work encompasses the end-to-end supply, delivery, installation, configuration, testing,
commissioning, and support of the edge router at Getz Pharma
5.1 Supply and Delivery
NETS shall supply and deliver the router along with the required hardware, SFP transceivers, dual power supplies,
software, and applicable licenses in accordance with the approved Bill of Materials (BOM) at the designated Getz
Pharma location.
5.2 Installation
NETS shall install the router at the designated site, including rack mounting, physical connectivity, power
connections, and initial hardware verification. NETS shall perform the installation in accordance with OEM
guidelines and the approved network architecture.
5.3 Configuration and Commissioning
NETS shall configure and commission the router in accordance with the approved network design and Getz
Pharma’s requirements. This shall include BGP peering, IPv4/IPv6 routing, routing policies, route filtering, required
routing protocols. NETS shall also configure the supported management and monitoring features, including SNMP,
Syslog, SSH, NTP, and network automation interfaces. NETS shall integrate the router with the existing network
infrastructure and implement the approved DR routing architecture.

NETS shall provide technical support for three years alongside OEM support in accordance with the agreed support
terms. The support arrangement shall include applicable firmware and software upgrades, security patches, bug
fixes, configuration backup, and hardware warranty/support services.
5.5 Testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
NETS shall conduct operational testing to validate network connectivity, route advertisement and reception,
routing table functionality, IPv4/IPv6 connectivity, and traffic forwarding, NETS shall also validate the configured
routing policies, interfaces, and monitoring capabilities. NETS shall support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with
Getz Pharma’s designated team to verify compliance with the agreed requirements before final handover.
5.6 Documentation and Handover
NETS shall provide the project plan, router and BGP configuration documentation, routing policy details, IP
addressing and peering documentation, operational and troubleshooting guides, and as-built documentation.
Upon successful commissioning and UAT, NETS shall formally hand over the operational solution and relevant
documentation to Getz Pharma.

The objective of this project is to acquire a robust and future-ready SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network)
solution encompassing its complete supply, deployment, and sustained maintenance. The proposed solution must
integrate seamlessly with Karachi Electric’s (KE) existing network infrastructure to deliver optimized connectivity,
enhanced reliability, and high-performance operations.
This initiative will act as a strategic foundation for KE’s transition toward a Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
framework, enabling the implementation of a unified, and security-centric network architecture. This transformation
is designed to optimize connectivity across KE’s geographically distributed sites by elevating network security,
simplifying operational management, and establish a unified, scalable, and flexible platform that meets KE’s dynamic
connectivity requirements and aligns with evolving cyber security standards.

The scope includes the procurement, supply, installation, integration, and maintenance of a comprehensive Software-
Defined Wide Area Network (SD-WAN) solution across KE’s primary, regional, and branch sites. This includes all the
tasks, responsibilities, and deliverables for the implementation of a Fortinet SD-WAN solution across the KE's data
center, disaster recovery (DR) site, and remote branches. The objective is to enhance network agility, improve
application performance, and reduce operational costs while ensuring secure connectivity between the data centers
and branch offices.

•
End-to-end supply of Fortinet devices as required, appropriately sized for the Data Center, DR site, and branch
locations.
•
Ensures the timely delivery of all hardware accessories including mounting kits, power supplies, transceivers,

Physical installation and initial setup of Fortinet SD-WAN appliances at the KE’s Primary Data Center, Disaster

The objective of this project is to supply and deploy enterprise-grade managed network switches to replace the
existing End-of-Life (EOL) switches within the production network environment. The proposed solution will
comprise managed switches, meeting the specified technical, lifecycle, warranty, support, and acceptance
requirements. The solution will support reliable 24×7 network operations with appropriate management,
switching, security, QoS, monitoring, and PoE capabilities.
5. Scope of Work
The scope of work encompasses the end-to-end supply, delivery, installation, configuration, testing,
commissioning, and support of the Managed Network Switches at KICT
5.1 Supply and Delivery
NETS will supply and deliver the required network switching equipment, comprising enterprise-grade 24-port
managed switches. All equipment will be brand new, genuine, unused, current-generation, and sourced through
authorized channels.
5.2 Installation and Configuration
NETS will install the supplied switches at the designated locations and perform the required physical installation,
rack mounting, power connectivity, and network cabling connections. The switches will be configured in
accordance with the KICT’s network requirements, including management access, VLANs, spanning-tree protocols,
and other applicable switching functions. For the PoE+ switches, configuration and verification will include PoE
functionality, per-port power control and monitoring, automatic PoE device detection, and confirmation of the
required power budget.

NETS will provide technical support on site on demand during the applicable support period. Support will cover
troubleshooting and assistance related to the supplied switching equipment and its implemented configuration.
The supplied equipment will include the OEM support for the specified duration, including NBD hardware
replacement, OEM technical support, firmware updates and RMA facility, as applicable.

NETS will conduct User Acceptance Testing following installation and configuration to verify that the supplied
solution meets the specified technical and operational requirements. Testing will include verification of network
connectivity, required switching features, management access, uplink functionality, and PoE functionality for the
PoE+ switches.

Upon successful completion of installation and UAT, NETS will provide the relevant final documentation and
complete the formal handover of the supplied solution. Documentation will include the applicable product
datasheets and part numbers, manufacturer authorization where applicable, support certificates, EOL/EOS
lifecycle confirmation, serial numbers, and country of origin.

4. Objective
The objective of this engagement is to deliver centralized monitoring and operational support for the Lucky Core
Industries’ network infrastructure across multiple locations. Through this service, NETS International will ensure
improved network visibility, rapid detection of incidents and timely troubleshooting support in order to maintain
stable and reliable network operations.
The proposed NOC services will cover the monitoring and operational support of network infrastructure devices
including firewalls, routers, switches, wireless controllers and access points deployed across Lucky Core
Industries’ network. The monitoring scope will include approximately 200 network devices distributed across 10
different sites. NETS International will utilize its enterprise monitoring platform MonetX to perform continuous
monitoring of the network environment and SupportX as the centralized helpdesk and ticketing system for
incident tracking and service management.

Under this engagement, NETS International will provide centralized monitoring and remote operational support
for the network infrastructure deployed at Lucky Core Industries. The scope of services includes monitoring of key
network devices such as firewalls, routers and switches installed across the LCI’s various locations. The total
number of network devices covered under this service is approximately 200 network devices deployed across 10
sites.

NETS International’s Network Operations Center (NOC) will continuously monitor the operational status,
availability and health of network devices deployed across Lucky Core Industries’ sites. This firewalls, routers,
switches, wireless controllers and access points that form the core of the LCI’s network infrastructure. Through
centralized monitoring systems, the NOC team will maintain real-time visibility into the network environment,
enabling early detection of device outages, connectivity issues, or abnormal behavior that may impact business
operations.

The monitoring platform will generate alerts and notifications whenever predefined thresholds are exceeded or
unusual events occur within the network environment. NOC engineers will actively monitor these alerts and
system events to quickly identify potential risks such as device failures, high utilization levels, or connectivity
disruptions. Prompt attention to alerts ensures that potential issues are investigated and addressed before they
escalate into major service disruptions.

Whenever an alert or service disruption is detected, the NOC team will analyze the event to determine whether it
represents a genuine incident affecting network operations. Engineers will conduct diagnostic checks and initiate
troubleshooting procedures to identify the nature and cause of the problem. Based on the findings, the NOC team
will take appropriate corrective actions to restore network functionality and minimize service interruptions.

section: Remote Technical Support for Network Issues
text:
NETS International will provide remote technical support to address network-related incidents and operational
challenges. Using secure remote access mechanisms, NOC engineers will perform configuration verification, log
analysis and diagnostic commands to investigate and resolve issues affecting the network infrastructure. This
approach enables rapid response and efficient problem resolution without the need for immediate physical
intervention at the site.

9

In cases where an issue cannot be resolved at the initial support level, the NOC team will follow a structured
escalation process. The incident will be escalated to higher-level technical specialists within NETS International for
further analysis and resolution. This escalation framework ensures that complex or critical issues receive the
appropriate level of expertise and attention required for effective resolution.

All alerts, incidents and service requests will be formally recorded and managed through the SupportX ticketing
system. Each issue will be logged as a service ticket, which will include detailed information about the problem,
troubleshooting activities performed and the resolution status. The ticketing system ensures proper
documentation, accountability and traceability of all support activities from the time an incident is reported until
it is fully resolved and closed.

The NOC team will monitor key performance indicators related to network operations to ensure that the
infrastructure continues to operate efficiently. Parameters such as device availability, interface utilization and
connectivity status will be observed through the MonetX monitoring platform. Continuous observation of
performance metrics helps identify potential performance degradation and ensures that the network remains
stable and responsive.

section: Fault Identification and Root Cause Analysis
text:
When a network fault occurs, the NOC engineers will perform detailed analysis to identify the underlying cause of
the issue. This includes reviewing logs, analyzing device behavior and evaluating network conditions leading up to
the incident. Root cause analysis helps in understanding the origin of the problem and supports the
implementation of corrective measures to prevent recurrence.

section: Coordination with Customer IT Teams for Resolution
text:
During the troubleshooting and resolution process, NETS International engineers will maintain close coordination
with Lucky Core Industries’ internal IT team. This collaboration may involve sharing diagnostic findings, requesting
access permissions, validating configuration changes, or coordinating on-site activities when necessary. Effective
communication ensures that issues are resolved efficiently and with minimal operational disruption.

Throughout the incident lifecycle, the NOC team will provide regular updates regarding the status of ongoing
issues, actions taken and expected resolution timelines. Detailed incident reports will be documented in the
SupportX system to maintain transparency and provide a clear record of support activities. These updates ensure
that the LCI remains informed about the progress of issue resolution and overall service performance.

10

6.1 Option 1: 24x7 Remote Support
NETS provides complete 24x7x365 remote support, diagnostics, event monitoring, log analysis and configuration
review. Under this service model, NETS International will provide remote monitoring and remote technical
support for the network infrastructure. The NOC team will continuously monitor alerts, network device status and
performance indicators through the MonetX monitoring platform. Whenever a network incident or alert is
generated, the NOC engineers will analyze the event, initiate remote diagnostics and attempt to resolve the issue
through remote access.
6.2 Option 2: 24x7 Remote + On-Site Support
This option includes 24x7 monitoring and remote troubleshooting, along with on-demand on-site support for
critical issues that cannot be resolved remotely. The NOC team will continuously monitor network alerts via
MonetX, log incidents in SupportX and coordinate with on-site engineers as required. This option ensures that
critical issues affecting business operations are addressed promptly both remotely and on-site when needed.
6.3 Option 3: Office Hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM) Remote Support
Under this option, the NOC provides remote monitoring and troubleshooting during business hours only, from
Monday to Friday. Alerts will be monitored via MonetX and incidents will be logged and managed in SupportX.
This option does not include on-site visits. Critical and high-priority incidents reported during office hours will be
responded to promptly, while medium and low-priority issues will be resolved according to the agreed schedule.
6.4 Option 4: Office Hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM) Remote + On-Site Support
This option combines remote monitoring during office hours with on-demand on-site support for critical
incidents. NOC engineers will monitor alerts through MonetX, manage tickets via SupportX and coordinate on-
site interventions if remote troubleshooting cannot resolve the issue. This ensures timely handling of critical
network incidents during business hours, while medium and low-priority issues are managed remotely.

NETS International follows a structured incident management workflow to ensure timely identification and
resolution of network issues. The process begins with continuous monitoring of the network infrastructure
through the MonetX platform, which generates alerts whenever abnormal conditions or device failures occur.
Once an alert is detected, the NOC team will analyze the event and create a corresponding service ticket in the
SupportX ticketing system.

The NOC engineers will then perform remote diagnostics and troubleshooting to identify the root cause of the
issue. If the issue can be resolved remotely, the engineers will implement corrective actions and restore normal
network operations. If the problem requires further investigation or physical intervention, the incident will be
escalated according to the defined support procedures. For service models that include on-site support, a NETS
engineer will be provided to the affected site to resolve the issue.
After the problem is resolved, the ticket will be updated with detailed resolution information and formally closed
in the SupportX system.

The objective of the project is to implement a Huawei GPON-based access network and deploy Huawei core
switching infrastructure for the Lucky One project. The solution comprises a Huawei SmartAX MA5800-X2 OLT,
associated GPON components and licenses, Huawei CloudEngine S6750-H48Y8C core switches, iMaster NCE-FAN
Lite management platform, technical support and maintenance services. The project will ensure proper delivery,
installation, deployment, configuration, commissioning and operational readiness of the proposed network
infrastructure.
5. Scope of Work

NETS International will be responsible for the delivery of the proposed Huawei networking equipment to the
designated project location. The delivered equipment will include the Huawei SmartAX MA5800-X2 OLT and
associated components, Huawei CloudEngine S6750-H48Y8C core switches, optical transceivers, high-speed
cables, power modules, rack-mounting accessories and other equipment included in the approved quotation.

The deployment, configuration, implementation and commissioning of the Huawei SmartAX MA5800-X2 OLT will
be performed by Huawei. The OLT implementation will include installation and deployment of the OLT platform
and its associated service/interface components, configuration of the GPON services and relevant licensed
capabilities, and commissioning of the OLT to ensure operational readiness. Huawei will perform the required
technical activities for bringing the OLT into service and validating its functionality as part of the implementation.

NETS International will be responsible for the complete implementation of the Huawei CloudEngine S6750-H48Y8C
core switches. The scope will include physical installation of the core switches, rack mounting, installation of power
modules and relevant accessories, installation of optical transceivers and high-speed cables, and physical
connectivity of the core switching infrastructure. NETS International will also perform the required configuration
and deployment activities for the core switches.

NETS International will configure and integrate the core switches with the implemented network infrastructure.
The activities will include configuration of required connectivity between the core switching infrastructure and the
access network, interface configuration, VLAN configuration, uplink configuration and other applicable network
parameters required for the intended operation of the solution. The core switches will be validated for connectivity
and operational functionality following configuration and integration.

The solution includes Huawei iMaster NCE-FAN Lite for access network management, to enable centralized
provisioning, monitoring, and automation of the GPON access network. All related software deployment,
configuration, and implementation activities will be carried out by Huawei as part of the project scope, including
NCE OS installation, NCE-FAN installation, and NCE-FAN upgrade activities.

8

5.6 Testing and Commissioning
Following installation, configuration and integration, the implemented infrastructure will undergo functional
testing and commissioning. Testing will cover the operational status of the OLT and core switching infrastructure,
connectivity between relevant network components, interface and uplink functionality, and basic service
validation. The OLT-related testing and commissioning activities will be performed by Huawei, while testing and
commissioning of the core switching infrastructure will be performed by NETS International.

Technical support and maintenance services will be provided for the supplied networking infrastructure in
accordance with the support services for 5 years. The support scope will cover the applicable Huawei MA5800-X2
OLT and CloudEngine S6750-H48Y8C core switching infrastructure and their associated covered components.
Technical support will be provided through both remote and onsite assistance. Remote support will be the primary
mode for troubleshooting, fault isolation, and resolution of issues related to the supplied infrastructure during the
applicable support period. Onsite support will be provided where required for critical issues that cannot be
resolved remotely or that require physical intervention at the site.

The project includes professional services covering access network implementation activities, NMS
implementation/commissioning, onsite optical network assurance/site visit activities and project management.
NETS International will coordinate the overall implementation activities and ensure coordination between the
relevant project stakeholders and Huawei for OLT implementation and commissioning.

This proposal outlines the provision of provide a dedicated Resident Engineer to deliver on-site operational support for
the MAL Pakistan's switching infrastructure. The Resident Engineer will assist with on-site technical support,
troubleshooting and maintenance tasks along with managing day-to-day operations related to LAN switching
environment during standard business hours. The objective of this engagement is to provide timely operational
support, perform routine administrative activities, troubleshoot switching-related issues and coordinate with the IT
team to maintain reliable network services across the organization.
5. Scope of Services
NETS shall provide one dedicated Resident Engineer responsible for the day-to-day management and operational
support of the MAL Pakistan's switching infrastructure. The scope of services under this engagement encompasses
end-to-end operational, administrative and support functions related to the switching infrastructure across MAL
Pakistan’s locations.

The Resident Engineer shall perform routine operational activities on the switching infrastructure, including
monitoring switch health, verifying interface status, checking VLAN availability, reviewing system logs and ensuring
that network devices remain operational. Any operational issues identified during routine checks shall be addressed
within the engineer's authority or escalated to the appropriate support team.

The Resident Engineer shall receive, acknowledge and perform initial troubleshooting for switching-related incidents
reported by MAL Pakistan. Responsibilities include identifying faulty ports, verifying physical connectivity, checking
interface status, validating VLAN assignments, reviewing error logs and restoring services through standard
operational procedures whenever possible.

The Resident Engineer shall support end-user connectivity requests related to the switching infrastructure. This
includes enabling or disabling switch ports, verifying port status, assigning approved VLANs, checking MAC address
learning, troubleshooting LAN connectivity issues and coordinating with relevant teams to restore network access.
5.4 MAC Address and Port Verification
The Resident Engineer shall verify switch port configurations, monitor MAC address tables, identify port-related issues
and assist in tracing end-user devices connected to the network. The engineer shall ensure that switch ports are
operating as intended and report any unauthorized or abnormal network connections.

The Resident Engineer shall perform basic configuration tasks on switching devices under approved change requests.
Such activities may include switch port configuration, VLAN assignment, interface descriptions, port shutdown or
activation and saving configuration changes. Any major configuration changes, network redesign, firmware upgrades,
or complex switching configurations shall be escalated to the designated engineering team.

The primary objective of this engagement is to ensure uninterrupted, secure and optimized operation of
Huawei-based production infrastructure deployed at JS Bank Limited through the renewal of OEM support
services by NETS International Communication Ltd. This initiative is designed to maintain high availability of
mission-critical banking applications by minimizing unplanned downtime through proactive monitoring, rapid
incident response and efficient hardware replacement services. It also aims to extend the lifecycle of the existing
Huawei infrastructure by ensuring continued OEM support, regular firmware updates and sustained
compatibility with evolving enterprise platforms such as VMware.
Furthermore, the engagement focuses on enhancing overall system performance and stability through periodic
health checks, performance tuning and proactive maintenance delivered under Huawei Key Assurance services.
It will ensure compliance and interoperability by validating compatibility of compute and storage systems with
VMware v9 or later versions, thereby aligning with future virtualization strategies. Additionally, the project will
optimize operational efficiency by providing centralized support management, reducing the operational burden
on JS Bank’s IT teams through a single point of contact and a structured,
5. Scope of Work
NETS International shall deliver OEM-backed support services covering Huawei compute and storage
infrastructure deployed at JS Bank Limited. The scope encompasses a comprehensive range of support services
designed to ensure operational continuity, system reliability and performance optimization. The detailed scope
is as follows:

The NETS International shall provide end-to-end hardware support services for all covered devices, including
diagnosis, troubleshooting and replacement of faulty components using genuine OEM parts. Huawei support will
be available to ensure timely response and restoration of services. In the event of critical hardware failures,
issues will be addressed through onsite support with defined service level agreements (SLAs), including options
for next business day (NBD) or 4-hour replacement, depending on the severity and service coverage.

The NETS International shall provide access to Huawei OEM software repositories to facilitate firmware updates,
patches and upgrades. This includes operating system and storage firmware updates, security patch
management, as well as bug fixes and performance enhancements. All updates will be carefully tested and
validated for compatibility within the existing environment prior to deployment to ensure minimal risk and
service disruption.

Huawei Key Assurance services will be delivered to enable proactive and preventive infrastructure support. This
will include periodic system health checks and diagnostics, structured firmware lifecycle management and early
detection of potential system failures. In addition, the service will provide performance optimization
recommendations along with capacity planning and scalability guidance. This approach ensures a transition from
reactive troubleshooting to proactive infrastructure management.

8

NETS International shall ensure that all supported infrastructure components maintain compatibility with
VMware v9 or later versions. This will involve validation of compatibility for servers and storage systems,
interoperability testing within the hypervisor environment and advisory support for system upgrades and
migrations. The objective is to ensure seamless integration with virtualization platforms and future readiness.

A structured incident management framework will be implemented to ensure efficient handling of all technical
issues. This will include 24x7 access to the OEM Technical Assistance Center (TAC), comprehensive ticket logging
and tracking mechanisms and a defined escalation process. Incidents will be managed based on severity levels
with clearly defined response and resolution timelines. For critical issues, detailed root cause analysis (RCA)
reports will be provided to prevent recurrence.

Support services will be delivered through a hybrid model combining both remote and onsite capabilities.
Remote support will include continuous monitoring, remote diagnostics, configuration assistance and
troubleshooting. Onsite support will cover physical hardware replacement, scheduled preventive maintenance
visits and hands-on support during critical incidents to ensure rapid resolution and minimal downtime.

The main goal of this project is to improve the organization’s wireless network to handle today’s requirements
and future growth. The objective is to deploy a next-generation wireless system that delivers significantly higher
data speeds and lower latency for seamless application usage. Additionally, the project aims to install advanced
access points that provide consistent and stable signal strength across all designated areas. Another key
objective is to implement a robust controller-based architecture that allows IT staff to manage, monitor and
troubleshoot the entire wireless network from a single dashboard. Finally, the solution is designed to establish a
flexible network foundation that can easily grow and adapt to support new devices.
5. Scope of Work
The scope of this project covers the end-to-end deployment of the new wireless system. NETS International will
handle the supply, installation and complete technical configuration of the Wireless Controller and Access
Points.
5.1 Supply & Installation
NETS International will supply all necessary hardware, including the Wireless LAN Controller, Indoor Access
Points. NETS will mount the Access Points (CW9164I & CW9162I) in the designated locations on ceilings or walls
to ensure the best possible signal coverage.. Furthermore, NETS will rack-mount the Wireless Controller (C9800-
L-F-K9) in the data center and connect it to the core network Switches.

NETS will perform the initial boot-up and basic setup of the C9800 Wireless Controller, which includes assigning
it a management IP address and a unique hostname. We will then configure the physical ports and logical
interfaces (VLANs) on the controller to ensure it communicates correctly with the rest of the network. We will
also set up security policies and authentication methods, such as passwords to ensure only authorized users can
connect to the Wi-Fi. Finally, NETS will create the required Wireless Network Names (SSIDs) for different user
groups, such as Staff, Guest and Management.

NETS will ensure that all new Access Points successfully discover and register with the central Wireless
Controller. Once connected, NETS will perform Radio Frequency (RF) tuning to configure the radio channels and
power levels on the Access Points, minimizing interference and maximizing speed. NETS will also assign specific
tags or profiles to Access Points based on their location to apply specific settings. To ensure security and
performance, NETS will update all Access Points to the latest stable software version.

The final stage involves rigorous performance validation, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for
throughput and failover redundancy, as well as an RF Heatmap survey to certify signal coverage. We will test the
Wi-Fi connection in various locations to confirm that devices can connect and browse the internet smoothly.
NETS will also verify that users can walk between different Access Points without losing their connection,
ensuring seamless roaming. A basic knowledge transfer session will be provided to walk the IT team through the
new dashboard and monitoring tools.

6.1 Cisco Catalyst 9800-L Wireless Controller
The Cisco Catalyst 9800-L Wireless Controller serves as the powerful foundation of this solution, built on the
industry-leading Cisco IOS XE operating system to provide an "Always-On" network experience that ensures
business operations never stop. Its standout feature is the use of Stateful Switchover (SSO) technology, which
allows the system to instantly switch to a backup controller if the primary one fails, while also enabling IT teams
to perform software updates and security patches without ever taking the network offline. Engineered for high-
throughput environments, the controller features robust internal hardware and high-speed 10 Gigabit Fiber
optic ports, enabling it to process massive amounts of data from thousands of users instantly without creating
bottlenecks. Beyond raw performance, this controller acts as a highly secure central command post with built-in
hardware trust technologies like Secure Boot to prevent tampering and advanced application visibility, allowing
IT staff to prioritize critical business tools.

The Cisco Wireless 9172 Series Access Points represent the cutting edge of wireless technology, utilizing the
latest Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) standard to deliver unprecedented speed and ultra-low latency through features like
Multi-Link Operation (MLO), which allows devices to transmit data over multiple bands simultaneously for a lag-
free experience. Designed for the most demanding high-density environments, these units feature a flexible
"Unified" architecture that enables management via on-premises controllers today or cloud-based dashboards
in the future without hardware replacement. To support massive data throughput and power redundancy, the
access point is equipped with dual Multigigabit Ethernet interfaces consisting of one 5 Gbps mGig port and one
2.5 Gbps mGig port (RJ-45), ensuring high-speed uplink connectivity and failover capabilities. Additionally, the
hardware includes a dedicated RJ-45 Console port for direct management, a USB 2.0 port (4.5W) for IoT
peripherals, and integrated radios for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) 5.4 and GNSS/GPS, providing a comprehensive
platform for next-generation smart workspace applications.
6.3 Cisco Wireless 9174 Series Access Points.
The Cisco Wireless 9174 Series Access Point is the most powerful and advanced Wi-Fi device available today,
designed for areas that need the absolute highest performance. It uses the newest Wi-Fi 7 technology, which is
like upgrading from a standard road to a futuristic super-highway, allowing devices to send data over two
separate bands at the same time so there is zero delay or "lag". To handle this massive speed without any
bottlenecks, the device is equipped with a robust set of physical interfaces (ports). It features a super-fast 10
Gigabit Ethernet port that connects to your wall for maximum internet flow, along with an extra 1 Gigabit
Ethernet port that can be used for backup connection or power redundancy. It also includes a standard RJ-45
Console port for engineers to configure the settings and a USB 2.0 port to power external smart devices. This
model is built to be flexible, meaning you can manage it with your local controller right now, but seamlessly
switch to cloud management in the future without buying new hardware, making it the perfect future-proof
choice for your network.

The primary objective of this project is to deploy network infrastructure that supports Al-Ghurair's operational
and connectivity needs at both its Islamabad and Karachi offices. This includes the supply and installation of
structured cabling, rack installation, enterprise-grade network hardware including enterprise switches, wireless
access points, and associated accessories, along with professional installation and one-time configuration of all
components to enable secure wired and wireless access. The project is focused on delivering a clean, fully tested,
and labelled physical network, aligned with industry standards to improve network visibility, maintainability.
5. Scope of Work
This turnkey project involves the supply, installation, and one-time configuration of both active and passive
network infrastructure components. The scope includes structured cabling, rack installation, device mounting,
cable termination, labelling, and initial configuration of switches and access points. All installed cables will be
tested and documented to ensure performance and compliance with standards.

We will supply all necessary active and passive network components required for the complete deployment of the
solution. This includes managed network switches, enterprise-grade wireless access points (APs), UTP patch cords,
and CAT6 structured cabling. Additionally, we will provide standard-sized network racks, including mounting
accessories such as cable ties, trunking, brackets, cable organizers, and other essential materials to ensure proper
physical deployment and cable management in accordance with industry best practices.
5.2 Deployment and Installation
Our team will perform the physical installation and deployment of all supplied components. This includes rack-
mounting of switches and access points, as well as structured cable laying within the premises. All network cables
will be properly routed, and terminated at patch panels and user outlets (faceplates). Access points and network
switches will be mounted securely, with installation of mounting brackets where required. We will also ensure
proper power and network connectivity for all installed active devices, including integration with patch panels and
structured cabling endpoints.

After installation, all network cables will undergo comprehensive testing using certified cable testers to ensure
proper continuity, signal strength, and performance compliance with industry standards. Each cable run will be
verified for correct termination, minimal signal loss, and optimal transmission quality. Testing will also include
validation of uplink connectivity between network devices (switches, routers, access points) to confirm seamless
integration and operational readiness of the entire infrastructure.

A one-time initial configuration will be performed on all active network devices, including switches and access
points. This will involve basic IP addressing, VLAN configuration (where applicable), and the setup of SSIDs for
wireless access. Switch ports will be configured with standard parameters to enable connectivity with access
points, printers, and other network endpoints. The devices will be made operational and ready for use, with
configurations aligned to the Al-Ghurair’s provided network design or basic implementation standards.

6.1 Cisco Meraki MX95-HW
The Cisco Meraki MX95-HW is a high-performance cloud-managed security and SD-WAN appliance designed for
medium to large branch deployments. It supports 4 WAN uplinks to ensure robust connectivity and seamless
failover. The device delivers up to 3 Gbps of stateful firewall throughput, 2.5 Gbps of maximum VPN throughput,
and 2 Gbps of advanced security throughput, making it suitable for environments requiring strong security and
high-speed data transfer. For high-performance networking, it includes 2x dedicated 10 Gigabit Ethernet SFP+
ports and 2x dedicated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 ports, offering flexible and high-capacity uplink options. with 3
years of OEM warranty and subscription-based support. The solution includes 3 years of OEM warranty and
subscription-based support, ensuring continuous access to firmware updates, cloud management features, and
vendor-level technical assistance.

The switch features 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T Class 4 PoE ports, delivering up to 30W per port, compliant with IEEE
802.3af/802.3at standards, along with 4x 1/10G SFP uplink ports for high-speed fiber connectivity. It includes a
USB-C console port, OOBM port, USB Type-A host port, and Bluetooth adapter for seamless management via the
CX Mobile app. With a fixed power supply delivering up to 370W PoE power and integrated cooling fans, it ensures
reliable performance. The switch package also includes a UK-localized power cord and Aruba 3-Year Foundation
Care Next Business Day (NBD) Exchange Service for the 6200F 24G CL4 4SFP+ 370W model, ensuring prompt
hardware replacement and support.

The HPE Aruba Networking AP-635 (RW) is a tri-radio indoor access point supporting concurrent 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz,
and 6 GHz (Wi-Fi 6E) with 2x2 MIMO, delivering up to 3.9 Gbps aggregate throughput. It features two integrated
dual-band downtilt omni-directional antennas and supports seven 160 MHz channels for high-performance, low-
latency applications. With dual HPE Smart Rate Ethernet ports (1–2.5 Gbps), it ensures business continuity and
true hitless failover for both data and power. The access point is backed by a 3-Year Aruba Central Foundation
Subscription and OEM warranty.

The objective of this project is to deploy, configure, test and commission a robust, secure and high-performance
Huawei data center infrastructure for the Bank of China (BOC). The proposed solution comprises Huawei
OceanStor Dorado 2000 enterprise storage, Huawei FusionCube compute infrastructure, Huawei CloudEngine
6800 Top-of-Rack (ToR) switches and the associated software licenses and support services.
NETS International will deliver the project as a complete infrastructure deployment, covering the installation and
configuration of the storage platform, compute infrastructure and virtualization environment. The solution will
be integrated to establish a reliable platform capable of supporting the BOC's enterprise applications and
virtualized workloads while ensuring operational efficiency and business continuity.
All implementation activities shall be performed in accordance with Huawei deployment guidelines, OEM best
practices and internationally accepted industry standards. Upon successful completion, the BOC will receive a fully
deployed and operational infrastructure platform validated through testing, commissioning and formal project
handover.

source: NETS-Bank of China- Technical Proposal - Huawei Network Compute & Storage (Sep 2026).pdf
text:
5.1 Pre Deployment and Site Readiness
The project will commence with a kick-off meeting to establish key project contacts, communication procedures,
roles and responsibilities, project scope, implementation approach and the overall project timeline. A site survey
and environmental audit shall also be conducted to verify rack space availability, power redundancy, cooling
requirements and network port availability prior to deployment.

source: NETS-Bank of China- Technical Proposal - Huawei Network Compute & Storage (Sep 2026).pdf
text:
The implementation team shall physically install the FusionCube compute nodes, OceanStor Dorado 2000
enclosure and CloudEngine 6800 ToR switches. The hardware shall be connected to the appropriate power
sources, including the configuration of redundant power supplies. Required interconnect cabling, including
Ethernet/FC front-end connections and SAS back-end expansion connections, shall be installed and properly
routed. All cables and relevant physical infrastructure shall be labeled for identification and future maintenance.

source: NETS-Bank of China- Technical Proposal - Huawei Network Compute & Storage (Sep 2026).pdf
text:
The implementation team shall physically install the Huawei CloudEngine 6800 TOR switches. The TOR switches
shall be connected to the required power sources and network infrastructure, with the supplied optical
transceivers and interconnect cabling installed as applicable. The implementation team shall perform the initial
configuration of the TOR switches, including management IP addressing, VLANs, trunking, native VLANs, uplink
interfaces and required interface configurations. The TOR switches shall be integrated with the FusionCube
compute environment to provide the required network connectivity for management, storage and virtual machine
traffic.

source: NETS-Bank of China- Technical Proposal - Huawei Network Compute & Storage (Sep 2026).pdf
text:
The implementation team shall initialize the management controllers of the host systems, including iBMC/BMC
interfaces. The OceanStor Dorado 2000 controllers shall be initialized and configured, including Active-Active
controller configuration, management IP addressing, DNS and NTP settings. System firmware shall be upgraded
and aligned with the validated target versions, including the FusionCube firmware stack and OceanStor Dorado
operating system.

8

5.5 Storage Infrastructure Configuration – OceanStor Dorado 2000
The storage infrastructure shall be configured on the OceanStor Dorado 2000. The implementation team shall
create RAID 2.0+ storage pools using the integrated SAS SSDs, with RAID 5, RAID 6, or RAID-TP configured
according to the approved design and requirements. SAN LUNs shall be provisioned using iSCSI or FC protocols, as
applicable, along with the required LUN Groups. Storage efficiency features, including SmartDedupe,
SmartCompression and Thin Provisioning, shall be enabled where applicable. Host Groups and initiator mappings
shall be configured for the FusionCube nodes, with UltraPath multipathing software or standard ALUA configured
as appropriate.

source: NETS-Bank of China- Technical Proposal - Huawei Network Compute & Storage (Sep 2026).pdf
text:
The required virtualization layer shall be deployed based on the Bank of China's requirements and the approved
design. This may include Huawei FusionCompute, VMware ESXi, or KVM, depending on the existing and newly
deployed hypervisor environment. The required management software, including FusionCube Center (FCC),
FusionCube Virtualization (FCV) and the applicable Data Center Management platform, shall be deployed and
configured. Network fabrics shall be configured, including Distributed Virtual Switches (DVS), Management VLANs,
Storage VLANs and VM traffic networks. The OceanStor Dorado 2000 LUNs shall then be integrated and presented
to the compute nodes as datastores or storage resources.
5.7 Testing & User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
The implemented solution shall undergo functional, redundancy, failover, performance and health verification
testing. Redundancy and failover testing shall include power supply failover on the compute nodes and storage
controllers, uplink link aggregation and multipath network path failover and storage controller failure and failover
testing. The implementation team shall verify the overall health of the environment and confirm an alarm-free
status through the DeviceManager and FusionCube management portals. Upon successful completion of testing,
the Bank of China acceptance checklist shall be executed and signed off as part of the User Acceptance Testing
(UAT).

The main objective of this project is to design and implement a secure and centrally managed network
infrastructure connecting the Head Office with all remote branch locations. The proposed solution includes the
supply of Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) to establish secure and resilient SD-WAN connectivity between all
sites, ensuring stable internet access and smooth operation of business-critical applications. The SD-WAN
architecture will provide intelligent traffic routing, link redundancy and enhanced security through advanced
threat protection features. Centralized monitoring and policy management will be enabled through a virtualized
management platform, allowing the IT team to manage all security policies and network configurations from a
single unified dashboard. In addition, the project includes the supply of secure switches for branch offices to
provide reliable connectivity for end devices. All hardware components will be physically delivered to their
respective locations, while deployment, configuration, SD-WAN setup and validation will be performed remotely
by certified engineers to ensure proper implementation and operational readiness.

technical services. NETS International will remotely configure all devices, implement SD-WAN settings and apply

technical support for a period of one-year from the date of commissioning. During this period, any configuration-

6.1 FortiGate 120G Series Next-Generation Firewall (Head Office)
The FortiGate 120G is a powerful security appliance designed for high-performance environments, housed in a 1
RU Rack Mount form factor. It offers exceptional connectivity with a wide range of interfaces, including 18x GE
RJ45 ports, 8x GE SFP slots, 4x 10GE SFP+ slots and 2x 10GE SFP+ FortiLink slots for high-speed uplink and
switching. Ideally suited for busy networks, it supports 3 Million concurrent sessions and delivers a massive
Firewall throughput of 39 Gbps, ensuring no bottlenecks in data transfer. For advanced security, it provides a
Threat Protection throughput of 2.8 Gbps, actively blocking cyber threats without slowing down the network.
Additionally, it ensures reliability with Dual AC Power Supplies, preventing downtime in case of a power failure.

6.2 FortiGate 70G Series Next-Generation Firewall (Branch)
The FortiGate 70G is a high-performance security appliance designed for distributed enterprise sites, housed in a
fanless Desktop form factor. It offers extensive connectivity with 10x GE RJ45 ports, including 2x GE RJ45 WAN
ports, 6x GE RJ45 Ethernet ports and 2x GE RJ45 FortiLink ports for high-speed switching. Ideally suited for secure
SD-WAN transformations, it supports 1.4 Million concurrent sessions and delivers a massive Firewall throughput
of 10 Gbps, ensuring no bottlenecks in performance. For advanced security, it provides a Threat Protection
throughput of 1.3 Gbps, actively preventing malicious traffic without compromising user experience. Additionally,
it relies on an external DC power adapter and includes a Signed Firmware Hardware Switch to ensure only valid
firmware is loaded.

9

6.3 FortiGate 30G Series Next-Generation Firewall (Branch)
The FortiGate 30G is a compact security appliance designed for small environments, housed in a reliable Desktop
form factor. It offers essential connectivity with 4x GE RJ45 ports, including 1x GE RJ45 WAN port, 2x GE RJ45 ports
and 1x GE RJ45 FortiLink port for integrated switching. Ideally suited for distributed enterprise sites, it supports
600,000 concurrent sessions and delivers a Firewall throughput of 4 Gbps, ensuring efficient data transfer. For
advanced security, it provides a Threat Protection throughput of 500 Mbps, actively blocking malicious content
without slowing down the network. Additionally, it operates with an external DC power adapter and features a
Trusted Platform Module (TPM) that hardens physical networking appliances.

This switch is designed for your branch offices to provide secure and fast connectivity. It features 24 Gigabit
Ethernet ports for connecting your devices and four high-speed 10 Gigabit uplinks for communicating with the
main network. Additionally, it includes 12 Power over Ethernet (PoE) ports with a total power budget of 185 Watts,
allowing you to power IP phones and cameras directly through the network cable without needing extra power
adapters.

6.5 Forti Switch 448E (48-Port)
This high-capacity switch is selected for your Head Office to handle a larger number of users and heavier data
traffic. It offers 48 Gigabit Ethernet ports to connect all your office equipment and four high-speed 10 Gigabit
uplinks for fast connection to your core network servers. It is designed for performance and reliability, ensuring
that your central operations run smoothly without bottlenecks.

The Forti Manager Virtual Machine (VM) is a software-based version of the hardware appliance that runs on
common virtualization platforms, offering all the same latest features to centrally manage your network security
devices. It is designed to scale easily, allowing you to manage anywhere from a few to thousands of devices using
a simple "stackable" subscription model that combines the software license and premium support into a single
package. These subscriptions are available in blocks for managing 10, 100, or 1,000 devices and you can simply
purchase multiple units to increase your device limit as your network grows. To operate, the system requires a
minimum of 4 virtual CPUs and 8 GB of memory, supporting between 1 and 12 network interfaces depending on
your configuration. Each license tier also includes a specific allowance for daily log storage; for example, the 10-
device license allows for 2 GB of logs per day, while the 100-device and 1,000-device licenses provide 5 GB and 10
GB per day, respectively.
